{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "label_pos",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "overall_craft_verdict",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "A clean ordinal quality scale (masterpiece..unwatchable) with well-separated categories, but it is essentially a proxy for overall sentiment/label_pos itself. Grouping on it largely restates the focus rather than opening an external relationship."
    },
    {
      "name": "script_writing_quality",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "A thematic dimension (writing craft) with interpretable, well-separated categories. It is a distinct aspect of a review that can be segmented and compared against sentiment to reveal which themes track positive vs negative labels."
    },
    {
      "name": "plot_originality",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable categories about narrative originality; a genuine review theme that can be cross-tabbed against sentiment. 'not_present' is frequent but categories remain meaningful for comparison."
    },
    {
      "name": "acting_quality",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "A separable performance theme with clear categories; strong candidate for segmentation against sentiment to explore theme differences."
    },
    {
      "name": "reviewer_emotional_response",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Categories are interpretable but the valence axis (positive vs negative emotion) is nearly collinear with label_pos, so it mostly restates the focus rather than exposing an external theme."
    },
    {
      "name": "rewatch_intent",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Behavioral-intent dimension that correlates with but is not identical to sentiment; segmenting on it can reveal how engagement themes vary and is an informative external variable."
    },
    {
      "name": "comparative_benchmark",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Captures a distinct rhetorical theme (comparison to peers/classics) with interpretable categories. Heavily 'not_present' (189) reduces power, but the remaining categories still support meaningful comparison."
    },
    {
      "name": "explicit_recommendation",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "A clean recommend/advise-against scale, but it is close to a direct expression of sentiment polarity and thus largely restates label_pos rather than a separate theme."
    },
    {
      "name": "genre_expectation_met",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "An expectation-fulfillment theme distinct from raw sentiment; interpretable categories that can be segmented to explore how met/failed expectations relate to positive vs negative labels."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.7,
  "rationale": "The set is well-designed for exploratory analysis: all columns use interpretable, well-separated categorical scales rather than opaque scores, and several (script, plot, acting, genre expectations, comparisons, rewatch intent) capture distinct review THEMES that can be cross-tabbed against sentiment to answer the query. The main weakness is redundancy: overall_craft_verdict, reviewer_emotional_response, and explicit_recommendation are near-proxies for label_pos and mostly restate the focus, and some columns are dominated by 'not_present', limiting segmentation power. Still, a majority provide genuine external, associational thematic variables, supporting good but not maximal informativeness."
}
